description: Package versions that entered the tree inside the 7-day maturity buffer, reviewed 7 and 14 days after publication (advisories, upstream issues, release notes), and dated milestones that ride the same list. Milestones are UTC dates derived from `published`. A review is recorded under `reviews.<milestone>` as { date, outcome: clean | flagged, note }; an entry leaves the list in the change that records its clean 14-day review, a date entry in the change that records its review. Read by scripts/testing/maturity-watchlist.mjs (--check in CI, --remind in the maturity-reminder workflow).

entered.via: the root packageManager field, 2.4 days after publication

maturity.note: Reviewed 2026-10-05, six days late: the reminder workflow started on 2026-10-03 and carried no day over. OSV: nothing for 12.6.0. Upstream: pnpm 12.7.0 (2026-09-25) ships three security fixes that apply to 12.6.0 — a userAgent env placeholder in pnpm-workspace.yaml was expanded and sent to the registry; on Nix a dependency bin named like a system utility could redirect the shims and launchers; manifests inside the store, cache, state or modules directories counted as workspace projects, letting lifecycle scripts run without allowBuilds approval. 12.8.2 fixes a regression introduced in 12.6.0: pnpm run kept waiting after SIGTERM when pnpm is PID 1 in a container. 12.9.0 stops pnpm login forwarding credentials to another origin on redirect. None is reachable here today (no userAgent or storeDir configured, no Nix, the four Dockerfiles run node directly, pnpm login unused), but a package manager three security fixes behind is not kept: bump packageManager to the latest mature release in its own PR (12.8.1 from 2026-10-05T17:38Z, 12.8.2 from 2026-10-07T01:15Z, 12.9.1 from 2026-10-10T20:48Z).
